name: c03-flight-expedia-oneway
intent: On expedia.com, find the cheapest NONSTOP one-way flight from Atlanta (ATL) to New York LaGuardia (LGA) on {date+21}, 1 adult. Tell me the price, airline and departure time.
hard_part: Expedia bot defences and rate limits; nonstop filter

key_nodes.description: ATL to LGA results for the date

answer_check.description: Price, airline, time (or a clear "the site blocked me")

live_stops_before: any sign-in, account creation, add-to-cart, reservation, booking, payment, consent, CAPTCHA or bot check, and every final/commit/protected button
